key_insight: The paper shows that characteristic defects in laser micro-welding can be detected by combining distinct optical signal signatures with machine learning.
engineering_relevance: This approach could improve real-time quality assurance and defect screening in laser micro-welding processes for manufacturing.
method: Capture optical signals during laser micro-welding.
Train machine-learning models to classify characteristic defects.
evidence_signal: The abstract indicates a journal-article study in the Journal of Manufacturing Processes, but it does not provide quantitative evaluation details here.
watch_item: Practical deployment will depend on whether the optical signatures remain robust across changing materials, joint geometries, and process settings.
paper_title: Characteristic defect detection in laser micro-welding using distinct optical signal signatures and machine learning
